reasons.plausibility: Al has very limited solubility in refractory BCC alloys and tends to form brittle intermetallics, making a single-phase solid solution with retained strength highly unlikely.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and quantitative, with specific composition, measurements, and rejection criteria, though the chosen composition may be unprocessable.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses the core trade-off but proposes a well-known problematic alloying strategy (Al in BCC RHEAs) without acknowledging the extensive literature on phase instability.
